description: HushMessenger for Messenger 580 (arm64 codes 346013387 and 346013440). 21 selectable patches. Hide People You May Know now also covers the Notifications tab. Long-press Messenger for Patch controls or Restart Messenger. Source updates do not change installed apps. Fresh sign-in/recovery and live ad removal remain unverified.

patches.name: Allow chat bubbles
patches.description: Removes the low-memory eligibility limit on Android 11 and newer. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide AI sticker tools
patches.description: Hides the generated-sticker tab and AI sticker suggestions. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide Chat Moments
patches.description: Hides the Chat Moments entry in the menu. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide Facebook shortcuts
patches.description: Hides Facebook toolbar, profile and sharing shortcuts. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide Meta AI buttons
patches.description: Hides the floating button, toolbar button and AI menu entries. Search stays available. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide People You May Know
patches.description: Hides suggested people in chats and on the Notifications tab. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide Reels badge
patches.description: Hides the Reels notification badge. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide avatar stickers
patches.description: Hides the avatar tab in the sticker keyboard. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide business reply suggestions

patches.name: Hide business typing suggestions
patches.description: Hides business suggestions as you type. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide chat promotions
patches.description: Hides Messenger quick-promotion banners inside conversations. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide event prompts
patches.description: Hides event quick-promotion prompts inside chats. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide friend request cards
patches.description: Hides friend request cards inside the inbox. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.description: Hides the inbox's add-more-people promotion unit. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide inbox ads
patches.description: Filters typed inbox ad items. Live ad removal still needs an affected-account check. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide inbox promotions
patches.description: Hides Messenger quick-promotion banners in the chat list. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide inbox tabs
patches.description: Hides the Home and Channels subtabs. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide stories and notes
patches.description: Hides the horizontal tray above chats. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Hide typing indicator
patches.description: Suppresses your outgoing active-typing signal. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

patches.name: Install beside Meta apps
patches.description: Renames two shared permissions so a re-signed Messenger can install beside Meta apps. Checked 580 builds only. Earlier clean installs stopped at a blank first-run screen.

patches.name: Open web links externally
patches.description: Uses Messenger's external-browser branch for HTTP and HTTPS links. Long-press Messenger > Patch controls. Starts off.

release_notes:
Signed installation testing found a blocker. A Messenger 580 APK patched with HushMessenger installed on the S25 using the same signing key as Hushfacebook, but Messenger stayed on a blank first-run screen. An unchanged APK rebuilt by Morphe did the same. The original stock APK opened its login form after reinstall.

The permission patch is unchanged. This release updates the warning in the patch source and README. The S25 requires account sign-in again, and chats, notifications and calls with a re-signed app remain unverified. Use this preview only with an account you can restore.

The local build passed 12 tests. Morphe Desktop 1.17.0 applied the v0.0.8 bundle to the exact S25 stock APK, Android verified its v3 signature, and a changed-APK check stopped before output. Two clean builds produced the same SHA-256 listed in SHA256SUMS.txt.
